subject: general
question: All the compounds of which of the following sets belongs to the same homologous series?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** (C3H8, C4H10, C5H12) are all **alkanes**, which belong to the same homologous series.
 
• A homologous series is a group of organic compounds that have a similar general formula, possess similar chemical properties, and show a gradation in physical properties.
 
• Alkanes follow the general formula **CₙH₂ₙ₊₂**, where n is the number of carbon atoms.
 
• In this series, with each subsequent compound, one **CH₂ unit** is added to the previous compound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2** includes C6H10, C6H12, C6H14, which are not in the same homologous series as they have different general formulas (alkenes, cycloalkanes, and alkanes respectively).
 
• **Option 3** includes C4H8, C5H8, C6H10, which do not belong to the same homologous series either.
 
• **Option 4** includes C2H6, C2H4, C2H2, which are alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes respectively and thus do not belong to the same homologous series.
